transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me a little bit about what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess what finally pushed me to come in is just that I'm having trouble sitting through things. 

I just keep getting up during important things, like... sprint planning at work, or even on mortgage calls. I know I should stay put, but I'll just... suddenly decide I need water, or that I have to go check something in the other room. So... yeah. That's mostly it.
Looking back at your life, did you experience this same difficulty staying seated or needing to move around when you were a child, say in elementary school?

Um... yeah, I guess so. My teachers in elementary school actually used to... move my desk sometimes. Or they'd have to remind me to stay in my seat. 

I guess I was just always popping up, or... talking before they called on me. And I'd rush through my work, even when I understood how to do it. So... yeah. I did do that back then, too.
